title: The ramp, rebuilt
logline: Gully's ramp with new planks, April 2023, pale beside the old gray ones, the pup, eight, on it. Built in 2014 for a dog with three legs; rebuilt for the same dog. The page counts the pale boards: three.

panels.composition: A plank ramp at a shingle shack's door with three new pale boards among the old gray ones, a small three-legged dog standing on the new boards, sawdust on the dock.
